slides.headline: 1 warehouse SOP to an AI skill in *20 min*
slides.sub: Here's the order I do it in.

slides.title: Pick a daily SOP
slides.body: Something that happens every day, like "where's my order" replies.

slides.title: Write it for a new hire
slides.body: The steps, in order, in plain words. No jargon.

slides.title: Add 3 real examples
slides.body: Good answers your team already sent. They teach tone faster than rules.

slides.title: Mark the yes points
slides.body: Refunds, promises, anything that leaves the building.

slides.title: Test on yesterday
slides.body: Run it on real work from yesterday. Compare with what your team did.

slides.headline: Want my *5 starter skills*?
slides.sub: Comment it and I'll DM you the pack.
